svg.text: A chain: each stage's gap forces the next idea, running from the problem (synapses too slow for flexible control)
through oscillation-based mechanisms to a final claim that wave computation is consciousness's engine — not a set
of independent arguments but one argument building step by step.

g.text: A straight chain down the page: a problem with synapse-only models leads to oscillations, then to a specific theory
(Spatial Computing), then to wave-based analog computation, then to consciousness and its rivals.

g.title: Flexible top-down control needs rapid coordination of millions of neurons — Synapse-only models seem too slow and cumbersome for this. — → spya-f6m6jv
Classical view: fixed, specialized neurons feeding forward — fails to explain mixed activity — → spya-k046f6
Many neurons are multifunctional (mixed selectivity) — requires dynamic routing — → spya-v0gbwq
Brain waves route signals via ephaptic coupling — faster than synapses alone — → spya-mapqhv
Spatial Computing: alpha/beta 'stencils' gate gamma/spiking — explains mixed selectivity & subspaces — → spya-qck2sw
Traveling waves shift which neurons are active — moves activity between coding states — → spya-y09vju
g.text: Traveling waves shift which neurons are active

g.title: Wave interference performs analog computation — parallel, energy-efficient — → spya-h5qjz4
Anesthesia disrupts large-scale waves, not specific receptors — → spya-uvev07
Synapses store; waves decide what's active now — → spya-dnv2tp
g.text: Synapses store; waves decide what's active now

g.title: Consciousness = organized, wave-coordinated cortex — → spya-smkrcs

g.text: A hub: the central idea (alpha/beta stencils gating gamma/spiking) radiates out to explain several separate findings —
it is one mechanism with multiple consequences, not a sequence.

g.title: Alpha/beta rhythms act as inhibitory 'stencils' on gamma/spiking — → spya-qck2sw
Gamma strongest in upper layers, alpha/beta in deep layers, across 4 species — → spya-thnz7b
Primate prefrontal data confirm stencils encode context, predict errors — → spya-azz3c8
Alpha/beta's millimeter scale suits top-down control — → spya-q606tk
Same neuron falls inside/outside stencil by context, producing mixed selectivity — → spya-zmknun

g.title: Stencils segregate population activity into orthogonal subspaces — → spya-m63zb9
Smooth population trajectories may be waves 'pulling' activity along — → spya-ah94dx
g.text: Smooth population trajectories may be waves
A chain that funnels to the final claim: traveling waves and analog computation, backed by anesthesia evidence,
converge on one conclusion about consciousness, which is then set against rival theories side by side.

g.title: Traveling alpha/beta waves accompany shifts in motor/prefrontal coding — → spya-y09vju
Slower theta waves organize activity at larger scale — → spya-jcpyd5

g.title: Analog computing: wave interference solves equations directly, in parallel — → spya-h5qjz4
Far more energy-efficient than digital computing — → spya-szhg6f
Different anesthetics converge on slow desynchronized waves — → spya-wnqgmn
Synapses store; waves select what's active now — → spya-dnv2tp

g.title: Compared with Global Workspace, Integrated Information, Higher-Order theories — shares themes, differs on mechanism — → spya-xn7mdj
Consciousness = brain-wide, wave-organized integration — → spya-smkrcs
